recipes.label: Goal: Paddock Bunker
recipes.startdescription: The city above has become a hell woven of ash and sulfur, but down here, deep underground, the air remains cool and damp, carrying the familiar scent of mold. Let us settle this quietly and leave as swiftly as possible.

recipes.label: Retrieval Completed
recipes.startdescription: The interior of the facility remains completely unscathed — well worth the immense effort I poured into building it and the care with which I just opened it myself. Deeper inside, my masterpiece also remains perfectly intact, waiting quietly for my retrieval.

recipes.label: Goal: The Black Bazaar
recipes.startdescription: Now, I'm starting to understand why the damned Suppression Bureau has been unable to clean up this city. The participants here likely outnumber the Bureau's own personnel—but no matter how many bidders there are, I'll be the winner tonight.

recipes.label: The Real Book of Prophecy?
recipes.startdescription: The moment I opened it, I understood—they could only glimpse fragments of words because those words were not meant for them. Now, before me, lines of shimmering text emerge clearly, their meaning unmistakable, shifting with every question that arises in my mind, as if the book itself were speaking to me. Should I trust its prophecies?

recipes.label: Goal: The Traitor's Grave
recipes.startdescription: I have no interest in the lineage of this body of mine—but there must be a reason behind the deliberate concealment here: perhaps some hidden interest, or perhaps a certain truth.

recipes.label: Legacy of the Red Rose
recipes.startdescription: It is widely believed that the children of the Red Rose have all turned to bleached bones in the calamity. This claim is not entirely accurate—for the few bodies before my eyes are clearly quite well‑preserved. In the coffin of one among them lies a conspicuous hidden compartment, concealing a long and heavy weapon.

recipes.label: Goal: The Collapsed Dock
recipes.startdescription: As far as I know, my ally isn't fragile, nor does he have a habit of oversleeping—the fact that he hasn't managed to break free yet must mean he's run into some trouble down there. I should go and see what it is.

recipes.label: A Little White Lie
recipes.startdescription:
'Wickle!!!' Inside the collapsed dock, just as I ignored Fissifer's shouts and removed the excess parts, his roar nearly flung my physical form off its feet. 'I won’t forget you left me here, with those damned imbeciles,' he hissed through clenched teeth. 'Your blasted promise had better still hold.'

‘Oh, it does,’ I replied at once. ‘And I still have the power to make sure it’s fulfilled.’ That was, of course, a lie—but there’s no harm in aiming high.

recipes.label: Goal: Lethe's Hideout
recipes.startdescription: Their hideout was neither hidden nor low-key—these days, you really have to deal with every bit of trouble yourself.

recipes.label: Back to It's Owner
recipes.startdescription: Mere mortals cannot possibly alter my creation; even after all this time, its structure remains as intact as ever. Moreover, there are still resources left in their stronghold.

recipes.label: Goal: Ruined Sanctuary
recipes.startdescription: Rummaging through a mess filled with the stench of copper is scarcely a dignified task. Best to finish this quickly.

recipes.label: An Unexpected Gain
recipes.startdescription: Though I’ve never held much fondness for Hokobald, I must admit that what lies before me is a rare and exquisite work; leaving it tucked away in some hidden nook would be a true waste. I fashioned for it a light‑tight, heat‑resistant container—so large that it could only be dragged away—and did not glance back at the room heavy with the odor of copper and filth.

recipes.label: Goal: Breeze Collection
recipes.startdescription: Searching within dust-shrouded display cabinets and long corridors—until I find my target, or until my target finds me first.

recipes.label: Stretched Too Thin
recipes.startdescription:
I have departed for another promising location.

[You cannot explore multiple Vaults at once.]

recipes.label: Bright, Yet Not as Before
recipes.startdescription: I shattered the guardianship of this unusual thing, then elevated it with my power—and so it understood, completely abandoning its resistance to me. Any being with wisdom knows to yield to the stronger to ensure survival, however ancient it may be, however glorious it once was.

recipes.label: Preperation
recipes.startdescription:
Manpower, tools, tangible supplies, and intangible power—any preparation may provide an advantage for the coming task.

[Overcome all obstacles to achieve the goal. Before beginning, you may commit two cards as preparation.]

recipes.label: 正在抽取阻碍......
recipes.commemts: 根据进度数量抽取不同的阻碍。

recipes.label: 阻碍判定器
recipes.commemts: 这一配方链接着所有在副本内将会出现的阻碍。

recipes.label: Narrow Escape
recipes.startdescription:
This obstacle should have left me stranded—but today, fortune smiles on me.

[Whether prepared or not, you always have a slight chance to pass an otherwise insurmountable obstacle.]

recipes.label: Press On
recipes.startdescription: I have overcome this obstacle, but more still lies ahead.

recipes.label: Failed!
recipes.startdescription: I failed to overcome the obstacles encountered during the exploration! The resources invested earlier will be wasted, and this action will leave a clear trace—

recipes.label: Exploration Stalled
recipes.startdescription:
I must attempt again soon—lingering too long will draw unwanted attention.

[This has a high chance of leaving Traces.]

recipes.label: 结束分配器
recipes.commemts: 这一配方链接着所有副本的结束文本。

recipes.label: Obstacle: Secrecy?
recipes.startdescription:
This is a covert operation. I need to create a diversion as cover, or I must exercise patience.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Secrecy: Misguidance
recipes.startdescription: I have left credible misdirection elsewhere; no one will know I was ever here.

recipes.label: Secrecy: Patience
recipes.startdescription: Most traces can be avoided with patience, but patience is a rare virtue.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Sealed Door
recipes.startdescription:
A sturdy door stands here. I could summon the power to open it wide, or simply melt it away entirely.
[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: A Sealed Door：Melted
recipes.startdescription: No matter what power once protected it, it will ultimately be reduced to a heap of molten slag and useless stone.

recipes.label: A Sealed Door：Opened
recipes.startdescription: All doors imply the intention to be opened; we only need to find the right key.

recipes.label: Obstacle: An Uncertain Location?
recipes.startdescription:
Before taking the next step, I need to pinpoint the target's exact location. I require the aid of illumination, or simply a key.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Locating: Illumination
recipes.startdescription: The right path is clearly revealed under the light. It is time to move forward.

recipes.label: Locating: Key
recipes.startdescription: A suitable key will lead us through the right door.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Cultists
recipes.startdescription:
I have many options: tear them apart with force, deceive them with trickery, or shatter their minds in blinding light.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Cultists：Crushed
recipes.startdescription: They fell like harvested wheat, their remains crushed to dust by overwhelming force. They never stood a chance.

recipes.label: Cultists：Gone Mad
recipes.startdescription: A sight no mortal could endure seized their minds—and it would be the only sight they would ever see again. There was no need to waste more time here.

recipes.label: Cultists：Deceived
recipes.startdescription: A simple trick — they'll never know I was here.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Ruins
recipes.startdescription:
Vast ruins lie strewn across the path I must travel. I need the power of reforging, or the power of opening, to clear the way.
[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Ruins：Melted
recipes.startdescription: Disturbing obstacles are melted, broken down, and swept from the path. There will be no more trouble.

recipes.label: Ruins：Opend
recipes.startdescription: The power of opening will ensure my path is safe and smooth. I shall pass through unhindered.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Procedure?
recipes.startdescription:
The shell of Fissifer was already in a state of poor maintenance, and lately it was heavily crushed without any preparation—now, the only way to get him moving again is to give up some of his components. I need either sharp tools or reforging power to get the job done.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: A Procedure: Reforge
recipes.startdescription: 'Ouch! You son of a—'

recipes.label: A Procedure: Sharp
recipes.startdescription: 'Oh! Damn it!'

recipes.label: Obstacle: Outer-Things?
recipes.startdescription:
An invader of the skin, its form twisted and grotesque in this side of the world. I need force, or the power that governs sealing and opening.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Outer-Things: Sharp
recipes.startdescription: Although it is twisted and terrifying in form, it is indeed a living being—and with absolute force, any living thing can be killed.

recipes.label: Outer-Things: Banishing
recipes.startdescription: It truly exists here, but it does not belong to this realm. A door opened in reverse can send it back to where it truly belongs.

recipes.label: Outer-Things: End
recipes.startdescription: This being shares the weaknesses of its close kin. In wordless solemnity, its activity shall meet its end.

recipes.label: Obstacle: Drowninng Curse?
recipes.startdescription:
A salty, damp scent swirls in the air ahead—only the powers of ceaselessness and devouring can overcome its corruption.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: Drowninng Curse: Ceaselessness
recipes.startdescription: Even under crushing weight, stifled into suffocation, and lashed by countless tides — the unceasing heart still dances, unyielding as ever.

recipes.label: Drowninng Curse: Devoured
recipes.startdescription: Like the Grail draining the Tide, it devours the power of curses. Even as the weight loosens and the tide recedes, it still thirsts for more.

recipes.label: Obstacle: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE
recipes.startdescription:
This—this is impossible. Even if he truly possesses the talent he boasts of, there is no way he could have established such powerful protection.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration...?]

recipes.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE: No Response?
recipes.startdescription: This power should be more than enough to contend with the strongest defenses, yet the spells that compose it seem to have no reaction at all?

recipes.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE: No Response?
recipes.startdescription: This power should be more than enough to contend with the strongest defenses, yet the spells that compose it seem to have no reaction at all?

recipes.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE: No Response?
recipes.startdescription: This power should be more than enough to contend with the strongest defenses, yet the spells that compose it seem to have no reaction at all?

recipes.label: THE ULTIMATE DEFENSE: Not Affected?
recipes.startdescription: Perhaps the previous intruder had disrupted its operation, or it never possessed genuine defensive capabilities from the start. I passed through safely, completely unimpeded.

recipes.label: Obstacle: A Great Seal
recipes.startdescription:
This item holds extra potency against Longs and other, mightier beings—yet my task remains unchanged in essence.

[Meeting any threshold of the obstacle allows progress in exploration.]

recipes.label: A Great Seal: Dismantled
recipes.startdescription: The searing red heat will break down and nullify the seal's power.

recipes.label: A Great Seal: Opened
recipes.startdescription: Some keys cannot be refused, no matter how fiercely the seal tries to repel them.
